prerequisites: Analytical strength calculation of connecting and gear elements

learning_outcomes.text: Students have an overview of software that can support them in the development of machines.
Students can design their own Excel calculations in a way that they are comprehensible to others.
Students know different types of gears for various applications.
Students can identify types of gears in professional life and everyday situations.
Students can understand calculation outputs from standard software.
Students can perform their own calculations with selected software.
Students apply the learned calculations from the Physics, Dynamics, and Gear Elements modules using different software.
Students learn further calculations for special types of gears (e.g., power branching, Willis equation, Kutzbach plan).

syllabus_topics: Analytical calculations (geometry, kinetics, kinematics, strength) for various types of gears:
Calculations include velocities, forces, transmissions, tolerance chains, strength calculations.
General and specific software for the design and representation of machine elements and their movements (e.g., Excel, ME calculation programs, computer algebra systems, CAD)
assessment_rules: To receive credit points, the module examination must be passed. The grade's relevance for the final grade is determined according to the study and examination regulations (SPO).
